note: Do Mi Sol up and back from the low Do over a drone. The old block-level Key choice (A, C, D) is moves (key any, first in A, where it sits low for a tenor), so the title names no count of keys and the line about another key opens with {{?key}}; the one care line keeps the singer on the low notes.

exercise.title: Do Mi Sol from any Do
exercise.why: Do Mi Sol is two skips of a fixed size, so it sounds the same from any Do, and moving it trains your ear on the shape and not on the notes.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Starting from the low {{1}}, sing {{1}}, {{3}}, {{5}} and back down. Sing it on the note names.
Practice until the three notes land without a slide.
_Don't reach for high notes: stay on the low {{1}}, {{3}} and {{5}}._
{{?key}}In another key the drone and all three notes move, and the two skips stay the same size.
